atoms.content: AdamW default eps=1e-8 combined with unclipped gradients (grad_clip_norm=0.0) caused parameter divergence at step 0 for uninitialized Pythia-14m architecture.
Repaired baseline configuration (AdamW lr=1e-4, adam_eps=1e-5, grad_clip_norm=1.0) achieves 100% finite training and probe metrics across multi-seed reference runs.
